newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cities' Sept CPI data due Sept 23/24 - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italy cities' Sept CPI data due Sept 23/24 - Istat.

text.p: Preliminary CPI data for September from the 10 Italian sample cities will be issued on September 23 and 24, national statistics institute Istat announced.

On Monday September 23, Turin, Milan, Bologna, Venice, Trieste and Perugia will give their data while on Tuesday September 24, figures will be issued by Genoa, Florence, Naples and Palermo. The data will be given at 1530 GMT.
Istat will announce the final national consumer price inflation rate for September at 0800 GMT on October 4.
August year-on-year inflation came in at 3.4 percent after 3.6 percent in July. -- Rome newsroom +392 66129589
